cases.name: simple scalar
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
spec:
  replicas: $(VAR)
cases.expected:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
spec:
  replicas: 5

cases.name: non-string scalar
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
spec:
  replicas: 1
cases.expected:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
spec:
  replicas: 1

cases.name: wrong path
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
spec:
  replicas: 1
cases.expected:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
spec:
  replicas: 1

cases.name: sequence
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
- $(FOO)
- $(BAR)
- $(BAZ)
- $(FOO)+$(BAR)
- $(BOOL)
- $(FLOAT)
cases.expected:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
- foo
- bar
- $(BAZ)
- foo+bar
- false
- 1.23

cases.name: maps
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
  FOO: $(FOO)
  BAR: $(BAR)
  BAZ: $(BAZ)
  PLUS: $(FOO)+$(BAR)
cases.expected:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
  FOO: foo
  BAR: bar
  BAZ: $(BAZ)
  PLUS: foo+bar

cases.name: complicated case
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
  slice1:
  - $(FOO)
  slice2:
    FOO: $(FOO)
    BAR: $(BAR)
    BOOL: false
    INT: 0
    SLICE:
    - $(FOO)
cases.expected:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
  slice1:
  - $(FOO)
  slice2:
    FOO: foo
    BAR: bar
    BOOL: false
    INT: 0
    SLICE:
    - $(FOO)

cases.name: null value
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
  FOO: null
cases.expected:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
  FOO: null

cases.name: non-string in sequence
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
  slice:
  - false
cases.expectedError: considering field 'data/slice' of object Deployment.v1.apps/dep.[noNs]: invalid value type expect a string

cases.name: invalid key in map
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
data:
  1: str
cases.expectedError: considering field 'data' of object Deployment.v1.apps/dep.[noNs]: invalid map key: value='1', tag='
